title: Which guidance applies to Password and Account Rules?

question.author: member_182
question.body: There seem to be different descriptions of password and account rules. What is the maintained CloudBox guidance?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Security documentation says: The Security panel of the web app lists all active sessions and lets you sign out individual devices. Repeated failed login attempts trigger a temporary lockout and an email notification. Account passwords must be at least 12 characters and cannot appear in known breach lists. Password resets are handled by verified email. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
